newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-CELTIC HIRE BROWN AS GENERAL MANAGER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CELTIC HIRE BROWN AS GENERAL MANAGER.

text.p: Celtic confirmed Jock Brown as their new general manager on Monday.
Brown, younger brother of Scotland coach Craig Brown, is a soccer commentator and a sports lawyer.
The appointment will raise eyebrows among Celtic fans because his brother spent the early part of his career at Glasgow rivals Rangers.
But Brown countered: "Right now there is no bigger Celtic fan in the country than me."
One of his first tasks will be to help find a coach to replace Tommy Burns who left Celtic last month.
